name: Halliburton

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Halliburton logo.svg, via commons.wikimedia.org)

description: Halliburton is an oilfield services company: oil and gas producers pay it per job, per day or per product to cement, fracture, stimulate and complete wells (Completion and Production) and to design, drill and evaluate them (Drilling and Evaluation, including drill bits, drilling fluids and directional drilling). Revenue is driven by customers' drilling and completion activity, so it follows rig counts and operator budgets; North America revenue fell 6% in 2025. About 39% of 2025 revenue was from the United States and no other single country exceeded 10%. FY2025 revenue was $22,184M (-3%) and operating income fell 41% to $2,260M after $831M of impairments and other charges.

employees.note: "Over 46,000 employees"; about 22 percent covered by collective bargaining agreements; operates in more than 70 countries.

businessLines.name: Completion and Production
businessLines.how: Customers pay per job for fracturing and stimulation, cementing, completion tools, artificial lift, intervention and specialty chemicals; mostly activity-priced services plus product sales.

businessLines.name: Drilling and Evaluation
businessLines.how: Customers pay per day, per job or per product for drill bits, drilling fluids (Baroid) and reservoir evaluation and wellbore placement services.

brands.name: Baroid
brands.note: Drilling fluid systems and completion fluids product service line inside Drilling and Evaluation; no separate revenue disclosed.

brands.name: Multi-Chem
brands.note: Specialty chemicals; part marked for sale, completion expected H1 2026.

whatsNext.text: Sale of a portion of the Multi-Chem chemicals business
